questions.question: A proverb says the king's heart is like a waterway in the LORD's hand. What does the LORD do with it?

answers.text: He directs it where He pleases
He lets it flow wherever it likes
He leaves it to the king's advisors

questions.question: A proverb says the LORD desires sacrifice more than doing righteousness and justice. True or false?
What does a proverb say happens to the man who shuts his ears to the cry of the poor?

answers.text: He too will cry out with no answer
He will find honor in the end
He will keep all his wealth
